Previous: re-baselined on backend-doctor 0.4.7 (245eddf4) at tree 053c463b61d564076147e9a830c207c972685cef (clean full checkout, deps installed, 0 FALLBACK — the CHANGELOG rule of backend-doctor #78), Pi standing ruling (baseline = what the merged doctor prints), task k1778c2hvae8e8vz9f5bbbbbb98g62hw; CR-2 200 -> 264 is the instrument change 0.4.5 -> 0.4.6/0.4.7 alone (0.4.6 already read 264 on 03ad21d), licensed by the doctor_version raise
semantics: RATCHET ONLY. Each `count` is a CEILING of non-conforming sites/rows for one mechanical rule. A deploy refuses when the evidence count for a baselined rule is ABOVE its count, when a red mechanical rule is not listed here, when a module listed under `modules` with 0 carries a site, or when any value here is HIGHER than the same value on origin/main. Values may only go down. Every count here was measured with the published @vantageos/backend-doctor named by `doctor_version`; the gate compares an evidence count with them only when the evidence's `cli_commit` reads `npm @vantageos/backend-doctor@<doctor_version>`, and refuses otherwise. A ceiling may rise against origin/main only in a re-baseline that raises `doctor_version` to a newer version in the same change (task k1778c2hvae8e8vz9f5bbbbbb98g62hw).
evidence_contract: The deploy evidence must carry `mechanical_rule_counts` {rule_id: int} (and `mechanical_rule_module_counts` {rule_id: {module: int}} for a rule with a zero-lane module). Without it the gate refuses; it never compares totals.
